cases.description: Test getSingleStep with Content instance of Text. It should handle text nodes and append 'text()' position path to the buffer.
Test getSingleStep with Content instance of Comment. It should handle comment nodes and append 'comment()' position path to the buffer.
Test getSingleStep with Content instance of ProcessingInstruction. It should handle processing instruction nodes and append 'processing-instruction()' position path to the buffer.

cases.expected: buffer with element name position path
cases.description: Test getSingleStep with Content instance of Element with no namespace. It should append the element name position path to the buffer.

cases.expected: buffer with namespace element position path
cases.description: Test getSingleStep with Content instance of Element with a namespace. It should append the complex XPath position path with namespace details to the buffer.
Test getSingleStep with Content instance that does not match any specific type. It should append a generic 'node()' position path to the buffer.
Test getSingleStep with Attribute instance with no namespace. It should append '@attributeName' to the buffer.
Test getSingleStep with Attribute instance with a namespace. It should append a complex XPath for attribute with namespace to the buffer.
Test getSingleStep with an instance that is not NamespaceAware. The buffer should remain unchanged.
Test getSingleStep with a null Content instance. The buffer should remain unchanged as there is no valid NamespaceAware instance.

cases.expected: buffer with element name position path
cases.description: Test getSingleStep with an Element instance that has no parent. It should append the element name position path to the buffer assuming no siblings.
Test getSingleStep with an Attribute instance that has no namespace and no parent. It should append '@attributeName' to the buffer.

cases.expected: buffer with namespace element position path
cases.description: Test getSingleStep with an Element instance with a namespace but no parent. It should append the complex XPath position path with namespace details to the buffer assuming no siblings.
Test getSingleStep with a Text instance that has a parent. It should append 'text()' position path to the buffer considering the parent's children.
Test getSingleStep with a null NamespaceAware instance. This should trigger a NullPointerException as the method tries to access methods on a null object.
